vulnerability.title: Vite dev server returns files outside server.fs.allow via ?import&raw because transformMiddleware never calls ensureServingAccess

fixed_releases.verified_content: At v5.1.8 transformMiddleware calls ensureServingAccess before serving any url matching rawRE or urlRE (transform.ts lines 162-168), and ensureServingAccess is exported from static.ts; at v5.0.11 the import/JS branch at transform.ts lines 137-142 runs without any fs check and asset.ts reads the ?raw file directly. The change 03f103383 is first contained in v5.1.8 and absent from v5.0.11 and v5.1.7.

severity.numeric_level_rationale: The CNA (GitHub_M) publishes 4.8 Medium and NVD carries that metric as its only, Secondary, metric (the record is Deferred with no NVD Primary analysis). The GitHub advisory publishes a different vector, CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N, which is 5.3 Medium, and also a CVSS 4.0 vector; both published CVSS 3.1 scores are Medium, so the level is consistent even though the vectors and scores differ.
severity.source: CNA / NVD Secondary security-advisories@github.com 4.8 Medium; GitHub advisory (OSV) 5.3 Medium

all_published_scores.source: GitHub advisory / OSV (computed base score for its own vector)

vulnerability.category_l2: Access control: the ?raw/?url import path in transformMiddleware never calls ensureServingAccess, so /@fs paths outside server.fs.allow and paths matched by server.fs.deny are served

description: In the Vite dev server, requests whose URL carries ?import&raw (or ?raw, ?url) are handled by transformMiddleware before serveStaticMiddleware/serveRawFsMiddleware. At v5.0.11 transformMiddleware's import/JS request branch (transform.ts lines 137-142) performs removeImportQuery (line 144) and unwrapId (line 147) and calls transformRequest (line 172) with no ensureServingAccess check; the resolver's /@fs branch returns the absolute path unconditionally, and the asset plugin's load hook (asset.ts lines 189-196) matches rawRE and returns await fsp.readFile(file, 'utf-8') at line 194. transformRequest's isFileServingAllowed check at transformRequest.ts line 212 only guards its fallback fs branch, which is not reached because the asset plugin already returns code. The /@fs allow-list and server.fs.deny checks in serveRawFsMiddleware (static.ts lines 181-191) therefore never run, so a client that can reach the dev server can read files outside server.fs.allow and files the deny list is meant to protect. The 5.1.8 fix 03f103383 exports ensureServingAccess and gates the rawRE/urlRE paths on it before the import branch.

critical_operation.description: The import/JS request branch of transformMiddleware. Requests with ?import&raw satisfy isImportRequest/isJSRequest and enter this branch; removeImportQuery (line 144) and unwrapId (line 147) leave a /@fs/<absolute path>?raw id, which transformRequest (line 172) resolves and the asset plugin loads with fsp.readFile (asset.ts line 194). No ensureServingAccess call guards this path; transformRequest's own isFileServingAllowed check (transformRequest.ts line 212) only guards its fallback fs branch, and the asset plugin returns code for the raw query before that fallback is considered, so the fs.allow/fs.deny checks that serveRawFsMiddleware applies to /@fs requests are bypassed. Extensionless targets also reach this branch with a plain ?raw through isJSRequest. The 5.1.8 fix inserts `if ((rawRE.test(url) || urlRE.test(url)) && !ensureServingAccess(url, server, res, next)) return` immediately before this branch.

entry_point.description: An HTTP request to the dev server for /@fs/<absolute path>?import&raw; transformMiddleware answers it before the raw-fs middleware can apply the allow-list check.

source_crosscheck.notes: CNA, NVD and the GitHub advisory agree on the mechanism (?import&raw bypasses the @fs allow-list) and on CWE-200/CWE-284. The CNA and NVD Secondary publish 4.8 Medium while the GitHub advisory publishes its own 5.3 Medium vector; both base scores are Medium, so the level is consistent even though the vectors differ. NVD is Deferred and adds no independent analysis or CPE. The CNA lumps the 5.x lines as >=5.0.0,<5.2.14 while the GHSA splits them; for the 5.0.11 snapshot the GHSA's 5.0.0-<5.1.8 range and the v5.1.8 fix (03f103383, the 5.1-branch cherry-pick of #18112) are the operative ones. The prior vite entries CVE-2024-31207 (picomatch matchBase) and CVE-2024-23331 (case-insensitive deny) are different root causes. The reviewer also noted that the public records disagree with each other: the CNA range is >=5.0.0,<5.2.14 and its patched list omits 5.1.8, while GHSA gives >=5.0.0,<=5.1.7 as affected (5.1.8 first patched), and the CNA's 4.x line is <4.5.5 while GHSA/OSV use <4.5.4. This entry records the 5.0/5.1 range and 5.1.8 fix that the reviewer verified in git.

independent_corrections_accepted: Line numbers corrected: removeImportQuery is line 144 (not 146), unwrapId is line 147 (not 149) and the transformRequest call is line 172 (not 157); the critical location 137-142 was already exact.
static.ts corrected: serveRawFsMiddleware starts at line 164 and its ensureServingAccess call is lines 181-191 (call 183-188), not 176-190.
Sibling backports re-labelled: 6820bb3b is the 5.4-line commit (parent v5.4.5) and a6da4508 is the 3.2-line commit (parent v3.2.10, contained in v3.2.11); the earlier git notes had them swapped.
03f103383 is the 5.1-branch cherry-pick of PR #18112 (parent v5.1.7, main merge 9d2413c8) and is not itself in the GHSA/CVE reference list; it is nevertheless the commit actually released in v5.1.8.

The statement that no isFileServingAllowed call exists on the path was too absolute: transformRequest.ts line 212 does call it, but only in the loadResult == null fallback branch, which the asset plugin's raw response never reaches.
asset.ts raw branch is lines 189-196 with readFile at 194 (the record said 189-195); the handler and trace now use 189-196.

Broader attack surface noted: extensionless targets such as /@fs/etc/passwd?raw also satisfy isJSRequest, so the advisory's ?import&raw is not the only trigger; this is why the fix checks both rawRE and urlRE.
review.duplicate_check: Reviewer confirmed CVE-2024-31207 (picomatch matchBase), CVE-2024-23331 (case-insensitive deny) and CVE-2024-45812 (DOM clobbering) have different root causes and do not share fix commit 03f103383.

limitations: Static verification only; no dev server was started and no HTTP request was sent.
The CNA's 5.x range is >=5.0.0,<5.2.14; the GHSA splits it into 5.0.0-<5.1.8, 5.2.0-<5.2.14, etc. This entry records the 5.0/5.1 branch range that contains the v5.0.11 snapshot.

The affected_range >=5.0.0,<5.1.8 uses the GHSA branch range; the whole 5.0.x line (5.0.0 through 5.0.13) and 5.1.0-5.1.7 are affected by the same code, and 5.1.8 is the first fixed release for this branch.
NVD is Deferred, has no Primary metric and no CPE configuration; the 4.8 Medium metric in NVD is the CNA's, imported as Secondary.
The GitHub advisory's own CVSS 3.1 vector differs from the CNA vector (5.3 vs 4.8; AV:N/AC:L vs AV:A/AC:H/UI:R); both are Medium and the record keeps both.

Public records disagree on the exact 4.x boundary (CNA <4.5.5, GHSA <4.5.4) and the CNA's patched list omits 5.1.8; this snapshot-based entry records the 5.0/5.1 range (5.0.0-<5.1.8) verified from git and the GHSA.
Extensionless targets can be read with a plain ?raw through isJSRequest, so ?import&raw is not the only trigger; the advisory text names only ?import&raw.

The reviewer verified the middleware order in server/index.ts (transformMiddleware at 769 before serveRawFsMiddleware at 772 and serveStaticMiddleware at 773), the /@fs resolver branch (resolve.ts 229-236) and transformRequest.ts line 212; nothing was started or executed.
open_questions: Whether the dev server is reachable by an untrusted client depends on deployment (default host is localhost; --host or server.host exposes it); the advisory and CNA vectors assume network reachability.
